subject: Action: SOC 2 Type II report request — audit window & transfer options
messages:
From: Lena Ortiz <lena.ortiz@acme-analytics.com>
To: olga_petrov@redwood.ai
Cc: Sam Patel <sam.patel@acme-analytics.com>
Date: Tue, 19 May 2026 09:14:00 -0700
Subject: Request: SOC 2 Type II report & bridge letter (audit window clarification)

Hi Olga,

Hope you’re well — we’re beginning our vendor assurance review for Q3 and need a copy of Redwood Inference’s SOC 2 Type II report covering the most recent 12‑month period, plus a bridge letter that clarifies the audit period and whether there have been any material control changes since the report date.

Two quick asks so we can route internally:
- Can you confirm the audit period for the Type II test (start/end dates)?
- What transfer options do you support for the full report and supporting artifacts (presigned S3, secure Drive, or other)?
- We may request a small telemetry sample (logs/metric snapshot) for two representative days within the audit window — can you provide guidance on sanitized sample delivery?

If it helps, Sam on procurement is looped here for any CM/contract questions. Our timeline is to complete review by 6/4 — can you confirm if you can share the report + bridge/consent by 5/26?

Thanks,
Lena Ortiz
Senior Security Analyst
Acme Analytics

Attachment: none

From: olga_petrov@redwood.ai <olga_petrov@redwood.ai>
To: Lena Ortiz <lena.ortiz@acme-analytics.com>
Cc: Sam Patel <sam.patel@acme-analytics.com>, kimberly_park@redwood.ai, ben_carter@redwood.ai
Date: Tue, 19 May 2026 11:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: SOC 2 Type II report & bridge letter (audit window clarification)

Hi Lena — thanks for the clear asks and timeline. Looping in Kimberly (Security) and Ben (Sales/Procurement) so we can address both the evidence and transfer/contract side.

Short answers / next steps:
1) Audit period: our most recent SOC 2 Type II covers 2024-01-01 to 2024-12-31. The attestation report date is 2025-02-15. We’ll include a brief bridge letter that states no material control changes through 2026-05-01 (or we can narrow to a different cutoff if you need).

2) Transfer options: we can provide the PDF report and bridge letter via (a) presigned S3 links (preferred for larger supporting zip files), (b) secure Google Drive link with restricted domain access, or (c) a secure SFTP drop. For telemetry samples we prefer presigned S3 with short TTL.

3) Telemetry/sample logs: we can produce a sanitized snapshot for two dates you pick inside the audit window (anonymized request IDs, truncated IPs, and redacted PII). Kimberly will outline the exact fields and the delivery manifest.

Proposed timeline:
- 5/21: Kimberly to share the telemetry manifest and confirm redaction rules.
- 5/24: We’ll upload the report + bridge letter and provide presigned links to your security mailbox.
- 5/26: Final clarifications (if any) — target to meet your 6/4 completion.

Quick templates you can use internally (one-liners):
- "Confirmed receipt of SOC 2 Type II report and bridge letter; looking through artifacts — will follow up by 5/28."
- "Accepting presigned S3 delivery; please send links and expected TTL."

Attachments: redwood-soc2-summary-2024.pdf (report summary)

Kimberly, can you post the telemetry manifest here by EOD? Ben, any procurement items Sam should expect (NDA/DocuSign) so we don’t slow the transfer?

Best,
Olga Petrov
Head of Compliance Operations
Redwood Inference

--
Olga Petrov
Redwood Inference

From: kimberly_park@redwood.ai <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>
To: olga_petrov@redwood.ai
Cc: Lena Ortiz <lena.ortiz@acme-analytics.com>, Sam Patel <sam.patel@acme-analytics.com>, ben_carter@redwood.ai
Date: Tue, 19 May 2026 13:18:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: SOC 2 Type II report & bridge letter (audit window clarification) — telemetry manifest

Thanks Olga / Lena — technical details below for the telemetry sample we can provide and the redaction steps.

Summary of what we can share (sanitized):
- Audit report PDF and bridge letter (PDF).
- Telemetry sample: request-level metadata only (request_id, model_id, timestamp, duration_ms, top_level_region, token_count).
- Optional: sample traces (span ids, latency buckets) with no stack traces or environment variables.

Redaction / anonymization rules:
- Strip full user content and PII before export. Replace request bodies with the first 32 characters hashed (sha256 truncated).
- Replace IP addresses with /24 masked value (e.g., 203.0.113.0/24).
- Remove any customer_id keys unless you confirm a narrow scope and signed consent.

Delivery options and filename conventions:
- Presigned S3 (recommended): bucket redwood-secure-transfer-prod, files: acme-analytics/soc2/20260519/report.pdf, acme-analytics/soc2/20260519/telemetry-sample-YYYYMMDD.csv.gz. TTL: 7 days by default, negotiable.
- Google Drive shared folder (domain-restricted).
- SFTP (enterprise customers only).

Bridge letter options:
- Standard bridge: confirms audit period and states any material changes up to an agreed cutoff date.
- Limited reliance consent: we can include a statement for the auditor that they may rely on the report for procurement decisions (requires DocuSign acceptance from Redwood Legal).

Please confirm which two dates you’d like for telemetry samples (we recommend one weekday + one weekend day to capture profile variance). Once you confirm, we’ll generate the exports and upload a small README (telemetry-sample-readme.txt) that describes column names and redaction notes.

Thanks,
Kimberly Park
Security Controls Manager
Redwood Inference

Attachment: telemetry-sample-readme.txt

From: Lena Ortiz <lena.ortiz@acme-analytics.com>
To: olga_petrov@redwood.ai
Cc: kimberly_park@redwood.ai, Sam Patel <sam.patel@acme-analytics.com>, ben_carter@redwood.ai
Date: Wed, 20 May 2026 10:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: SOC 2 Type II report & bridge letter (audit window clarification)

Olga / Kimberly — thanks for the fast turnaround and the options. We’d like: 
- Telemetry sample dates: 2024-06-12 (weekday) and 2024-07-03 (weekend).
- Presigned S3 is fine; please set TTL to 10 days.
- We will need the bridge letter to state audit coverage 2024-01-01 to 2024-12-31 and confirm there were no material control changes through 2026-05-01.
- For the bridge letter "limited reliance" option, we’re okay with standard wording; please send the DocuSign link so our legal team can sign if needed.

Sam (procurement) — please confirm if Acme needs an NDA or any procurement form before we pull the artifacts.

One-line confirmation for us: "Acme accepts presigned S3 delivery for SOC 2 artifacts; sending requested telemetry dates and awaiting DocuSign for bridge consent."

Thanks again — looking forward to the files.

Best,
Lena Ortiz
Senior Security Analyst
Acme Analytics
